plain: An old English court that tried cases in secret and was known for abuse of power

webster.text: Formerly, a court of criminal jurisdiction in England.

example.quote: He could however he said get over all these, if the rights of the Citizens were not rendered insecure 1. by the general power of the Legislature to make what laws they may please to call necessary and proper. 2. raise armies and money without limit. 3. to establish a tribunal without juries, which will be a Star-chamber as to Civil cases.
example.cite: James Madison, Notes of Debates in the Federal Convention of 1787, September 15, 1787
